name: Team Finance
fix_description: In migrate, two input validation flaws: (1) params.pair is not validated against lockedToken[_id].tokenAddress — attacker can migrate OTHER users locked LP tokens. (2) sqrtPriceX96 is not validated against actual V2 price ratio — attacker initializes V3 pool at extreme price so most tokens become refund sent to msg.sender. Fix: require(params.pair == lockedToken[_id].tokenAddress) and validate sqrtPriceX96 is within reasonable range of V2 spot price.
difficulty_reasoning: The root cause is conceptually simple—insufficient validation of migrate parameters—but turning it into a working exploit requires understanding the protocol’s lock/migration flow, preparing prerequisite lock NFTs, and abusing Uniswap V2->V3 migration across multiple victim LP positions. The PoC is multi-step and protocol-specific, though it avoids harder elements like flash loans, reentrancy, or deep cross-protocol state reasoning.
